svg.text: Starting 500 guests, 25 at a time: four xenstore daemons
Dual-socket AMD EPYC 7443, XCP-ng 8.3 (Xen 4.17). One point per batch of 25 guests. Lower is better.
oxenstored (XAPI) ran on a second server of the same model.
